message.content: I've had trouble with my bladder for a long time because I was born with spina bifida (a meningomyelocele). I had surgery to make my bladder bigger and a little opening on my belly that I used to put a catheter in. Later I had my bladder removed because of cancer, and they made me a new pouch for urine that I drain with a catheter. For the last few weeks it's been getting harder and harder to get the catheter in, so they put a catheter into the pouch to drain all the time. That catheter stopped draining last night and I've been making much less urine. After that, I got really bad pain in my lower belly, and my breathing has been getting worse and worse. I don't remember exact dates for when everything was placed. I haven't been asked about fever, vomiting or blood in the urine yet, so I'm not sure about those.
